name: Qwen3.8 Omni Flash
description: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash is Alibaba/Qwen's native omnimodal API model (id qwen3.8-omni-flash) for agentic audio-visual task execution. Inputs: text, image, audio, and video; output: text. Supports a 1M-token context window, reasoning_effort (xhigh/medium/low), and OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions / Responses APIs on QwenCloud (DashScope). Released 2026-09-18 as API-only (no open weights on this card). Vendor paper/blog highlights include WildClawBench-MM 71.0, UniClawBench 69.6, LongAudioSpan Accuracy 82.7, OmniVideoBench 63.4 static / 67.8 agentic (Qwen Code), MMAU 81.8, MMAR 79.8, MMSU 82.1, VoiceBench 91.6, OmniGAIA 74.0, DailyOmni 85.1. Catalog rows are limited to existing benchmark ids; UniClawBench, LongAudioSpan, OmniVideoBench, MMAR, and MMSU have no catalog ids yet and are noted here only. No first-party provider price row in this repo — available_in_zeroeval is false.

benchmarks.name: DailyOmni
benchmarks.description: DailyOmni evaluates multimodal models on daily-life video understanding tasks.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Audio-visual understanding; Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash column in paper Table 5

benchmarks.name: MMAU
benchmarks.description: A massive multi-task audio understanding and reasoning benchmark comprising 10,000 carefully curated audio clips paired with human-annotated natural language questions spanning speech, environmental sounds, and music. Requires expert-level knowledge and complex reasoning across 27 distinct skills.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Audio understanding; Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash column in paper Table 3

benchmarks.name: OmniGAIA
benchmarks.description: OmniGAIA evaluates multimodal perception and reasoning in agentic contexts, testing a model's ability to process diverse inputs and perform complex multi-step reasoning tasks.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Evaluated without an external agent harness; Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash column in paper Table 6

benchmarks.name: VoiceBench Avg
benchmarks.description: VoiceBench is the first benchmark designed to provide a multi-faceted evaluation of LLM-based voice assistants, evaluating capabilities including general knowledge, instruction-following, reasoning, and safety using both synthetic and real spoken instruction data with diverse speaker characteristics and environmental conditions.
benchmarks.analysis_method: Audio interaction aggregate; Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash column in paper Table 3
benchmarks.verification_notes: Vendor self-reported VoiceBench 91.6 mapped to catalog id voicebench-avg.

benchmarks.name: WildClawBench
